children: The Bank of Canada has leeway to wait before raising interest rates, says Carl Gomez, chief economist at Centurion Asset Management. Gomez tells WSJ that core inflation, which strips out food and energy, sits at a comfortable 1.9%, or just below BOC's 2% target. He believes the BOC holds on Wednesday, while setting the stage for potential hike "to show markets that they are still vigilant on inflation risks." (paul.vieira@wsj.com; @paulvieira)
